headline: Yi-Chia Chen adds 4.08 to ARC-3 lead

sections.text: Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model gained 4.08 to reach 75.56, holding first place on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The score gain extends a lead that Chen established earlier in the week; the public standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
